title: Alarms being cut-off and canceled
symptom: High/Low alarms will not sound properly. When triggered I get a fraction of a second of sound only, so all I hear is a brief beep. The alarms are then snoozed (without me cancelling them) for 30 mins. Pressing the Test Alarm button in settings also gives beep only.
cause: The app Battery Doctor, which the user installed to improve battery life, was snoozing the alerts.
fix: Delete the Battery Doctor app. The user confirmed that after uninstalling Battery Doctor, the alarms worked correctly. The latest nightly also contains a workaround that ignores alert cancellations within 3 seconds of being raised.
evidence_quote: I have fixed the problem. The App that was snoozing the alerts was Battery Doctor (which I installed to try to improve the battery life on the S6). Deleted the App and Xdrip alarms now working.
